# UI/UX Pro Max

Source: https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill

The upstream project contains multiple specialized skills including design, design-system, UI styling, brand and platform-specific guidance.

## Manager 90 adaptation
- Use design-system thinking before styling individual screens.
- Establish typography, spacing, color, radius, elevation, interaction and responsive rules as a coherent system.
- Prefer intentional hierarchy over equal-weight cards and generic dashboard grids.
- Validate accessibility, responsive behavior, interaction states and visual consistency.
- Keep the РЕСО brand palette as the source of truth; do not import the upstream project's own brand as Manager 90 branding.
- Use the specialized upstream sub-skills conceptually where relevant rather than combining incompatible visual systems.
